title: The back-rank mate
summary: When your own pawns trap your king.

steps.text: A king tucked behind three unmoved pawns is safe from most attacks - but it has no escape square. A rook or queen landing on the back rank can then be mate. Defend by giving your king a *luft* (a pawn move like h3) or by keeping a piece on the back rank.

steps.hint: The black rook is too far away to help.
steps.success: Rb8# - nothing can block or capture.
